data.body: DUPLICATE of 8a4f-f0f4-ed92-4c70 (Bound loadgroup worker respawns with --max-worker-restart=0), whose fix already merged to main at 53eaea07aa2 while this ticket sat open: --max-worker-restart=0 on the integration (loadgroup) lane makes the first worker death abort the session immediately via triggershutdown instead of re-dispatching the crashing item to respawned workers up to numprocesses*4 times and burning toward the 60-min job cap. That is exactly the resilience defect this ticket describes (observed on job 97060825848, hung 40+ min after a worker death). Linked duplicates; close this against the live link (--class=duplicate) once 8a4f closes.
